Apps on the allowlist are never blocked during any session.
Delete all statistics and event logs? Session history will be removed. This cannot be undone.
Delete profiles, schedules, statistics, and allowlist entries? Default profiles will be restored. This cannot be undone.
All data deleted. Default profiles restored.

Focus stores all data locally on your device. We do not collect, transmit, or sell personal data. Statistics, profiles, and session logs remain on your phone unless you export them manually.

Permissions are used only for focus blocking: usage stats and accessibility detect foreground apps; notifications show session status; exact alarms run schedules and session timers.

You can delete all data at any time in Settings → Data.

Some settings are unavailable during hard lock.
Hard lock adds Settings, installers, and other launchers to the block list for the session. Focus uses accessibility and usage stats to detect foreground apps and show the block screen quickly.
Safe mode, ADB, factory reset, and secondary users can bypass any non-system app. Focus does not claim otherwise — these limits are by design on standard Android.
Device admin is active. It helps protect hard lock sessions from launcher and settings bypass.
